facts.text: Michigan Tech offers the Enterprise Program, a project-based curriculum where multidisciplinary student teams operate like companies on real-world client projects.

sources.title: What is Enterprise? | Enterprise - Michigan Technological University
sources.quote: available to students from any major at Michigan Tech. Enterprise is student-driven, multidisciplinary teams that work like companies on real-world client projects, whether the deliverable is an innovative product, a pioneering solution, or a much-needed service.
